title: Render structured logs without control injection or secret leakage
instruction: Complete build_log_record(template, fields, secret_fields=()) as a strict structured-log renderer. template is a non-empty control-free string whose placeholders use only exact {identifier} syntax. fields is a mapping of string identifiers to control-free strings; every field must appear exactly once and no undeclared, repeated, conversion, format, attribute, index, or unmatched-brace placeholder is allowed. secret_fields is a duplicate-free list, tuple, or set naming only declared fields. Replace secret values with [REDACTED] in both message and structured fields. Return exactly message and a detached fields dict; validate atomically and never mutate inputs. Add tests and no dependencies.

author_metadata.notes: Wave-4 injection lineage combining strict formatting, control rejection, and consistent secret redaction.
